description.value: The Douglas J. Husband Discovery Centre is a local history museum in Tsawwassen operated by the City of Delta. Located near the BC Ferries Tsawwassen terminal, it could be a convenient stop for touring cyclists arriving from or departing to Vancouver Island. The centre falls under Delta's Museum & Heritage program and focuses on the community's history.
